name: Google I/O 2026
description: Google's annual developer conference. Key announcements: Android XR seriousness, Gemini 2.5 updates, Project Astra live demo, Gemini Spark (multimodal for kids), free-tier Gemini limits.
why_watching: Android XR as a credible Apple Vision Pro alternative, and whether Google's AI integration across devices finally feels cohesive.

name: WWDC 2026
description: Apple's annual developer conference. Tagline: "Coming Bright Up." genai.apple.com subdomain registered ahead of the event.
why_watching: Siri overhaul / Apple Intelligence 2.0, on-device vs. cloud framing, Matter camera support, developer AI tooling. Avatar acquisition signals spatial/embodied AI direction.

name: Gartner Summit Las Vegas 2026
description: Gartner's annual Las Vegas summit — typically focused on data, analytics, and enterprise AI adoption. Confirm exact event name closer to the date; Gartner runs multiple branded events at this venue.
why_watching: Gartner's market research shapes enterprise AI buying decisions. The hype cycles, quadrants, and vendor positioning announced here ripple through IT budget cycles for the following year.

name: AWS Summit Washington DC 2026
description: One of the largest AWS Summit stops in North America. Enterprise cloud, AI/ML services, and government/public sector cloud adoption are the dominant tracks.
why_watching: DC Summit draws heavy government and regulated-industry attendance — a signal for where federal AI adoption and cloud mandates are heading.

name: AWS Summit New York 2026
description: The East Coast flagship AWS Summit at the Javits Center. Bedrock, SageMaker, and agentic AI deployment patterns are typically the centerpiece announcements.
why_watching: NYC Summit tends to be where AWS makes enterprise AI announcements for the second half of the year — a preview of what re:Invent will expand on in December.

name: SpaceX IPO (SPCX)
description: S-1 filed. $18.67B in 2025 revenue. Listing under SPCX on Nasdaq, potentially as early as June 12.
why_watching: Starlink is the actual revenue engine. The IPO separates SpaceX from xAI/Tesla financial entanglement — watch the prospectus framing.

name: Star Wars Celebration 2027
description: Lucasfilm's official fan convention. With The Mandalorian and Grogu in theaters in 2026, expect major announcements on the next chapter of the franchise — streaming, gaming, theme park, and live experiences.
why_watching: Star Wars Celebration is where Disney signals the next 2-3 years of the franchise. Galaxy's Edge XR expansions, gaming tie-ins, and spatial entertainment plays get their first airing here.

name: Tribeca Film Festival 2026
description: Tribeca's immersive and XR track is one of the highest-profile venues for spatial storytelling. VR/AR narrative experiences compete alongside traditional film.
why_watching: Bellwether for whether XR storytelling is maturing as a medium — strong years here correlate with increased studio investment in spatial content.

name: AWE USA 2026
description: Augmented World Expo. Evan Spiegel keynoting for the second year running — likely a Snap Spectacles preview ahead of fall launch.
why_watching: Spiegel keynote is a Snap Spectacles signal. Also the right venue for the Anduril/Meta military XR conversation the industry keeps avoiding.

name: San Diego Comic-Con 2026
description: The largest pop culture convention in North America. Major studio panels, IP announcements, and increasingly a venue for XR/gaming experiences and spatial entertainment previews.
why_watching: SDCC is where Disney, Warner, and streaming platforms make their biggest entertainment bets public. With Mandalorian in theaters and XR storytelling expanding, expect spatial/immersive tie-ins.

name: Samsung Galaxy Unpacked
description: Z Fold 8, Flip 8, and Samsung's first smart glasses — both display and display-less variants expected.
why_watching: First real Android XR glasses hardware. Display quality vs. Meta Ray-Bans is the make-or-break comparison — LetinAR optics supply chain is the leading indicator.

name: SIGGRAPH 2026
description: The premier computer graphics and interactive techniques conference. AI-generated imagery, real-time rendering, 3D Gaussian splatting, and spatial computing research converge here.
why_watching: Where the techniques that ship in consumer products 18 months later get their first public airing. Watch for generative 3D and world model papers.

name: Venice Immersive 2026
description: The XR track of the Venice Film Festival — the highest-prestige venue for narrative XR and spatial cinema. Works premiering here signal where serious storytellers are pushing the medium.
why_watching: Venice Immersive is where the art-end of XR gets validated. If spatial cinema is going to break through culturally, it shows up here first.

name: Snap Spectacles Consumer Launch
description: Consumer AR glasses at ~$2,500. Evan Spiegel has been building toward this for years — the Spectacles developer edition has been the proving ground.
why_watching: The display quality question is the make-or-break. If Spectacles can deliver a compelling FOV at that price point, it resets the market.

name: OpenAI IPO
description: OpenAI targeting September 2026 IPO. Currently losing $1.25 per $1 of revenue. Microsoft partnership terms and compute costs are the story.
why_watching: The unit economics have to change between now and the S-1. Watch for revenue guidance and how they frame the path to profitability.

name: Meta Connect 2026
description: Meta's annual XR event. New smart glasses teased. Likely Quest 4 and/or mixed reality hardware alongside Orion AR glasses updates.
why_watching: The four-month smart glasses gauntlet (Google → Snap → Samsung → Meta) ends here. By September the competitive landscape will be clear.

name: New York Comic Con 2026
description: The East Coast counterpart to SDCC. Major publisher, studio, and streaming announcements with strong gaming and animation presence at Javits Center.
why_watching: NYCC tends to surface the holiday season entertainment slate and Q1 streaming content. Watch for XR experience announcements tied to major IP.

name: Qualcomm Snapdragon Summit 2026
description: Qualcomm's annual chip reveal event. Snapdragon 8 Elite successor and new XR chipsets expected — the silicon that goes into next year's smart glasses and headsets.
why_watching: Snapdragon XR silicon is the supply chain foundation for most glasses announced earlier in the year. Power efficiency and on-device AI performance are the metrics.

name: Adobe MAX 2026
description: Adobe's annual creative conference. Firefly generative AI updates, 3D and spatial design tools, and the evolving role of AI in the professional creative workflow.
why_watching: Adobe is the leading indicator for how generative AI integrates into professional creative tools — Firefly's trajectory here shapes what designers and media producers adopt.

name: Formnext 2026
description: The world's leading trade show for additive manufacturing and 3D printing. Bambu Lab, Prusa, Creality, and enterprise players all exhibit.
why_watching: Formnext is where prosumer 3D printing market shifts happen. After Bambu Lab's A1 safety issues, watch for Prusa and Creality share moves and any recall fallout.

name: AWS re:Invent 2026
description: Amazon's annual cloud and AI infrastructure conference. Where enterprise AI deployment patterns, pricing, and tooling get defined for the following year.
why_watching: re:Invent is where enterprise AI moves from lab to production at scale. Bedrock and SageMaker roadmaps set the tone for the AWS AI ecosystem.

name: NeurIPS 2026
description: The most influential AI research conference. Frontier lab paper drops, embodied AI research, and the first public look at what the next generation of models can do.
why_watching: NeurIPS papers become products 12-18 months later. The techniques that make it into GPT and Claude next year get their first airing here.

name: CES 2027
description: The Consumer Electronics Show — the year's first look at where major hardware platforms are heading. Smart glasses, AI companions, and home robotics will all have significant floor presence.
why_watching: CES sets the consumer device narrative for the year. The XR glasses shown here in 2027 will tell you whether the 2026 smart glasses wave delivered.

name: MWC 2027
description: Mobile World Congress — where telecom meets AI and XR. 5G/6G infrastructure, connected device ecosystems, and carrier partnerships for always-connected smart glasses.
why_watching: MWC is where the connectivity layer for XR and IoT gets negotiated. Carrier deals for smart glasses data plans signal whether the market is real.

name: SXSW 2027
description: South by Southwest. Tech, media, and culture intersection. XR and AI content creation tracks have grown significantly in recent years.
why_watching: SXSW is where tech narratives cross into mainstream culture. The AI-and-creativity conversation lands here before it reaches policy and mass media.

name: GDC 2027
description: Game Developers Conference. XR gaming, real-time 3D tooling, and AI-generated game content. Unity and Unreal Engine roadmaps drop here.
why_watching: Game engines are the de facto spatial computing development platform. GDC reveals what XR developers will build with for the next two years.

name: Nvidia GTC 2027
description: Nvidia's GPU Technology Conference. New GPU architectures, AI model training infrastructure, world model research, and robotics simulation platforms.
why_watching: Jensen Huang's keynote sets the AI hardware roadmap. Nvidia's silicon choices determine what's possible in AI training and XR rendering for the next two years.

name: NAB Show 2027
description: National Association of Broadcasters show. AI in media production, spatial audio, volumetric video, and the evolving broadcast tech stack.
why_watching: NAB is where media production technology shifts become commercial products. Volumetric capture, AI editing tools, and spatial audio pipelines all debut here.

name: Microsoft Build 2027
description: Microsoft's annual developer conference. Azure AI, Copilot platform updates, and developer tooling across the Microsoft stack.
why_watching: Microsoft Build is where enterprise AI tooling gets defined. Copilot and Azure AI roadmaps determine what the developer ecosystem builds on for the following year.
